assets.prompt: Polished navy medical header; smooth noncirrhotic liver cutaway with single lobulated mass and central stellate scar; no text, no diagnostic scan.
assets.review: Author visually inspected; schematic only; not a diagnostic image.

assets.verified: Publisher rights section includes figures unless otherwise credited; no separate figure restriction. Downloaded PMC mirror; author inspected full image. A native CT; B arterial; C delayed; D T2; E DWI; F hepatobiliary. ADC unavailable, so DWI alone not called restriction.
assets.selection: Young noncirrhotic case with clear large lobulated mass, arterial heterogeneity and central scar. Histology and molecular testing confirmed FLC. Typical teaching morphology; do not infer every FLC has the same scar signal.
